4.source_text: After fruitless search for a suitable house in which to convene meetings, I was compelled to rent a small hut, with an entrance something under four feet high, and it the only medium of lighting the interior, excluding the crevices in the roof, through which heaven’s bright luminary darted his thousand golclcn beams.
